class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, a, b, g, α, β, γ, ε, t):
        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
        b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
        g = np.asarray(g, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = a.shape[0]
        assert a.shape == (dim_0,)
        assert b.shape == (dim_0,)
        assert g.shape == (dim_0,)
        assert np.ndim(α) == 0
        assert np.ndim(β) == 0
        assert np.ndim(γ) == 0
        assert np.ndim(ε) == 0
        assert np.ndim(t) == 0
        # s_i = -α ((β a_i + (1-β) g_i)/(1-β^t)) / (sqrt((γ b_i + (1-γ) g_i²)/(1-γ^t)) + ε)
        self.s = np.zeros(dim_0)
        for i in range(1, dim_0+1):
            self.s[i-1] = -(α * (((β * a[i-1] + (1 - β) * g[i-1])) / ((1 - np.power(np.asarray(β, dtype=np.float64), t))))) / ((np.sqrt(((γ * b[i-1] + (1 - γ) * np.power(np.asarray(g[i-1], dtype=np.float64), 2))) / ((1 - np.power(np.asarray(γ, dtype=np.float64), t)))) + ε))
